deadline.value: No closing date for research degrees; two start periods (September and March). Apply early.
deadline.quote: No closing dates apply for application for higher degrees by research but there are only two registration periods (September and March).

supervisor.value: Contact a supervisor first; the formal application link is given only if a supervisor offers you a place.
supervisor.quote: Following contact with your potential supervisor, if you are offered a place, you will be given a link to the admissions website through which you will need to make a formal application.

funding.value: Funding comes from national programmes (SFI, IRC), College scholarships or individual supervisors; no blanket guarantee is stated.
funding.quote: Research students obtain funding from a number of sources. These include national programmes (e.g. SFI and the IRC), College scholarships and direct funding from individual supervisors.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: PhD takes three to four years.
